title: Prime Berawa Plot Near Finns Beach Club
description: A rare flat plot in the heart of Berawa, one of Canggu's strongest short-term rental micro-markets. The land sits 300 metres from Finns Beach Club on a quiet 4-metre paved lane, surrounded by operating villas with proven occupancy. Tourism zoning allows villa development with short-term rental licensing. Electricity is at the road and a deep well or PDAM connection is available.
investmentNote: Berawa land trades at a premium for a reason: walkable beach access and year-round demand. An efficient 3-4 bedroom villa build here targets a 12-15% net yield on total project cost, with strong exit liquidity to both investors and end users.
